name: ema_crossover_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, EMA(12)/(36) crossovers in range-bound intraday sessions attract late retail algo entries at precisely the moment the 60-90 second price impulse has exhausted — the crossover fires 1-2 minutes after the directional move began. When NIFTY's current 5-minute ATR is below 1.3x the 30-minute ATR baseline (range-bound regime), these crossover chasers create predictable supply/demand imbalance on the wrong side of an over-extended move. The 10-second confirmation wait (2 bars for price to cross back through the slow EMA) distinguishes genuine reversions from breakouts: if NIFTY is truly trending, it will NOT recross the slow EMA within 2 bars of the crossover, so only clean fade setups pass.
core_signal_oneliner: Fade an EMA(12)/EMA(36) crossover that reverses within 2 bars (10s), in a range-bound ATR regime, from the VWAP-extended side
